parameters.specification/query:
// DAX Query
DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
	FILTER(
		KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('EVRi BYOD'[DateTimeOpened])),
		AND(
			AND(
				'EVRi BYOD'[DateTimeOpened] >= DATE(2026, 4, 1),
				'EVRi BYOD'[DateTimeOpened] < DATE(2026, 5, 1)
			),
			'EVRi BYOD'[DateTimeOpened] >= DATE(2026, 1, 1)
		)
	)

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(__DS0FilterTable, "Open_Ticket_Count", IGNORE('EVRi BYOD'[Open Ticket Count]))

DEFINE
    // Calculate the 1st and last day of the previous month dynamically
    VAR __PrevMonthStart = EOMONTH(TODAY(), -2) + 1
    VAR __PrevMonthEnd = EOMONTH(TODAY(), -1)

    VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
        FILTER(
            KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('EVRi BYOD'[Account Name])),
            SEARCH("Evri", 'EVRi BYOD'[Account Name], 1, 0) >= 1
        )

    VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
        FILTER(
            KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('EVRi BYOD'[DateTimeOpened])),
            'EVRi BYOD'[DateTimeOpened] >= __PrevMonthStart &&
            'EVRi BYOD'[DateTimeOpened] <= __PrevMonthEnd
        )

EVALUATE
    CALCULATETABLE(
        SUMMARIZE(
            'EVRi BYOD',
            'EVRi BYOD'[Case Number],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Account Name],
            'EVRi BYOD'[End User / Partner],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Subject],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Open],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Closed],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Case Owner],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Contact Name],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Customer Reference],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Resolution Code],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Status],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Case Owner Role],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Internal Reference],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Resolution Type],
            'EVRi BYOD'[DateTimeOpened],
            'EVRi BYOD'[IsRecent],
            'EVRi BYOD'[DateTimeClosed],
            'EVRi BYOD'[First Name],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Last Name],
            'EVRi BYOD'[Number]
        ),
        KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable),
        KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable2)
    )

DEFINE
    VAR __PrevMonthStart = EOMONTH(TODAY(), -2) + 1
    VAR __PrevMonthEnd = EOMONTH(TODAY(), -1)

    VAR __SQDS0FilterTable = 
        FILTER(
            KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('EVRi BYOD'[DateTimeOpened])),
            'EVRi BYOD'[DateTimeOpened] >= __PrevMonthStart &&
            'EVRi BYOD'[DateTimeOpened] <= __PrevMonthEnd
        )

    VAR __SQDS0Core = 
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
            'EVRi BYOD'[Customer Reference],
            __SQDS0FilterTable,
            "Open_Ticket_Count", 'EVRi BYOD'[Open Ticket Count]
        )

EVALUATE
    TOPN(20, __SQDS0Core, [Open_Ticket_Count], 0)
ORDER BY
    [Open_Ticket_Count] DESC
